diagnosis.summary: The nightly run 5cb066f9 for 2026-10-01 failed at `transform`. An undeployed edit to dim_customers changed `c.country` to `c.country_iso`, a column that stg_customers doesn't have, so dbt failed with a Binder Error. Upstream data didn't change: the customers file header still matches the contract and the previous day. The proposed fix reverts dim_customers to the deployed version; it hasn't been applied or tested yet.

root_cause.explanation: dim_customers differs from the deployed version by one line: the final select reads c.country_iso instead of c.country. stg_customers (unchanged) and raw.customers only have `country`, so the model fails to bind and the dbt build fails (1 model failed, 2 skipped). Ingest succeeded and the 2026-10-01 landing file has the same shape as 2026-09-30, which rules out upstream schema drift.

evidence.claim: The transform step failed because dim_customers hit a Binder Error on c.country_iso; ingest succeeded.
dim_customers is the only changed model, and its diff replaces c.country with c.country_iso.
stg_customers is unchanged and exposes `country`, not `country_iso`.
The upstream customers file for 2026-10-01 matches the contract and the 2026-09-30 file, and the ingest config is at defaults, so there was no schema drift.
The runbook says a model error after a deploy should be fixed by reverting the changed model.

alternatives_considered: Upstream renamed country to country_iso (apply_column_mapping): rejected because the landing header is unchanged and still uses `country`.
Intentional business-logic change, so escalate to analytics_engineering: unlikely, because the edit points at a column that doesn't exist anywhere and can never build.
Transient failure (rerun_only): rejected because the error is a deterministic binder error.

proposal.rationale: An undeployed edit to dim_customers changed `c.country` to `c.country_iso`. stg_customers has no country_iso column, so dbt fails with a Binder Error. The upstream customers file and the raw contract have not changed: the column is still `country`, ingest succeeded and the ingest config is at defaults. That makes this a bad model change, not schema drift. The runbook says to revert the changed model.

applied: reverted models/marts/dim_customers.sql to the deployed version
